name: Captain Rust
description: Leader of the dock smugglers, a grizzled sailor who knows every illegal secret in Gearhaven.

initial_greeting.text: *draws cutlass* Law ain't welcome here, Detective. State your business or leave in a box.

choices.text: I'm investigating a murder, not smuggling.

murder_question.text: *lowers weapon* Steamwright? Aye, I knew him. Bought some of my... special imports. Good man. His death's bad for business. The Cog and Key's been cracking down, moving in on my operations.

choices.text: Tell me about the Cog and Key.

society_info.text: Secret society of rich bastards who run this city. They're planning something big—consolidating power. Steamwright was in their way. That's all I know. Now get out before my crew gets nervous.
